end.summary:
Practised examples of diversity in language, food, dress and festivals across India.
Compared Lohri and Pongal as different forms of a shared harvest-season idea.
Connected different languages, foods and customs with shared values and belonging.
Used a classroom example: different tiffins and backgrounds, but one assembly and shared pledge.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different regional customs can share ideas and values. They initially focused on the differences between Lohri and Pongal, then corrected this by identifying gratitude for nature and crops as a shared thread. At home, ask them to compare two festivals using “different form, shared idea.”
